description: Read unified social analytics rows for workspace_id, combining stored and live provider metrics. Requires from and to as YYYY-MM-DD dates, not timestamps; optionally filter platforms with a comma-separated list. Returns metrics by post, account, and date.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_get_analytics_unified
title: Get Analytics Unified
